semantics.definition: The code that draws any of the characters in the 3D world: it loads a character’s model, its look and its wings when the character is first shown, puts them into the world’s own three.js scene, standing as tall as a character is, and plays what its state says: standing plainly, or its walk or its run. And the numbers the characters carry: their height and the room they take up, how they move, their flight into a system, and the eye that follows them.
semantics.responsibility: Hold what several Eidos components share, once. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Draw any of the characters in the world’s three.js scene, standing, walking or running, at Eidos’s height.
